outputs.location: RESULTS — "MeCP2 and HIPK2 cooperate in inducing apoptosis" paragraph (tumor cells)
outputs.excerpt: Surprisingly, in tumor cells (i.e., HeLa, RKO, U2OS, or spontaneously transformed NIH-3T3 cells), we found neither induction of cell death by MeCP2 overexpression nor the additive effect by its expression with HIPK2 (data not shown); this suggests that the divergent response to MeCP2 overexpression might depend on tumor transformation.
